data.title: Exclusive: Sygnum rolls out MultiSYG bitcoin loans as BTC hits 80% of collateral
data.description: Investing.com-- Swiss digital asset bank Sygnum is launching bitcoin-backed loans in which client collateral is held in multi-signature wallets rather than by the bank alone, as holders look to borrow against their coins without giving up security, Investing.com has learned.
